That night, as the beam turned above him, Elias quietly felt less alone than he had in years, as though someone out there had heard the light.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝色的睡意里。高楼退去喧嚣，只剩几扇窗亮着，像未合上的眼。街道被路灯洗得安静，偶尔有出租车驶过，把灯光拖成细长的影子。远处早点摊升起第一缕白雾，烟火气轻轻叩醒街巷。风带着露水穿过楼宇，海棠花在微寒中颤动。城市在黎明前松开爪子，呼吸缓慢而真实。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same kind of problem again, but smaller.\n- You keep repeating that smaller version until you reach a simple case with an obvious answer.\n- Then you pass each answer back up, like nesting dolls opening one layer at a time."}
